caps.network: strictly zero http:// or https:// references

mechanics: Instant <1.5s zero-tutorial hook: drag-aim & release physics ricochet / drop-merge chain combos against numbered/destructible hazards
Between-wave 3-card roguelite upgrade draft (split-shot, gravity well, chain lightning, magnet, shield) scaling through Wave 10+
Procedural game-feel juice: hit-stop, screen-shake, floating combo damage numbers, and zero-asset WebAudio procedural synth SFX
Near-miss revive hook: awaiting_revive state on defeat allowing 1 extra shield/bomb continue (ready for Mini-App Stars / standalone play)

methods.reset(seed_u32): Reset PRNG and arena deterministically with zero Math.random() drift
methods.step(dt_ms, {x, y, down, tap, choice}): Advance simulation by dt_ms (16.67ms) and draw to <canvas>
methods.state(): Return {phase, wave, score, entities, combo, game_over, awaiting_revive}
